svg.aria-label: NeuraOS for Linux Mint: chat, code, create and agents on your own machine; local models on your GPU, coding agents behind approvals, an MCP server, Voice Type, desktop control, Wayland-ready

g.text: for Linux Mint · chat, code, create, agents — on your own machine
FOUR SPACES · ONE ORB · CTRL+K REACHES EVERYTHING
Free models, your keys, or your GPU
Plan drafts, Build runs with approvals
A coding agent on the folder you open
Files, a real terminal, parallel worktrees
Pictures with SD / FLUX.2 on your GPU
or a cloud image model, one click
Everything waiting for your OK, in one place
Shows your GPU and what fits, then downloads llama.cpp
(Vulkan or CPU). No sudo. Ollama, whisper.cpp, sd.cpp found.
Every write and permission is a card and a desktop
notification with Allow / Reject. Keep working elsewhere.
freeai4u-desktop --mcp: local chat, images, status, open,
and desktop control for Claude Code and any MCP client.
Hold, speak, let go: typed into VS Code, the terminal, the
browser. whisper.cpp on your machine, or Hugging Face.
See the screen, act on the desktop
Ctrl+Alt+S screenshots into the chat; a model may click,
type and press keys, each behind an Allow card.
Nemo actions, tray, start at login, bubblewrap sandbox,
login keyring for secrets, portals on Mint 23.
or the AppImage · or the apt repo for Update Manager
